projection.note: x = (lon - center.lon) * mPerDegLon (east, meters); y = (lat - center.lat) * mPerDegLat (north, meters). Spherical earth R=6371000. Engine mapping: (x, y) -> three.js (x, -z), y-up.

defaults.note: Fields with *Source: 'default' were not tagged in OSM and use these Bulgarian urban defaults (ЗДвП чл. 21: 50 km/h urban, 20 km/h living zone).
